prediction.sql: WITH card_client AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, cd.card_id, cd.type AS card_type, cd.issued FROM card AS cd JOIN disp AS d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE cd.issued = '1996-10-21'), client_accounts AS (SELECT cc.client_id, cc.gender, cc.birth_date, cc.district_id, cc.card_id, cc.card_type, cc.issued, a.account_id FROM card_client AS cc JOIN disp AS d2 ON d2.client_id = cc.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d2.account_id), trans_stats AS (SELECT ca.client_id, ca.gender, ca.birth_date, ca.district_id, ca.card_id, ca.card_type, ca.issued, ca.account_id, t.trans_id, t.date AS transaction_date, t.type AS transaction_type, t.amount AS largest_transaction_amount, t.balance AS balance_after_transaction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM client_accounts AS ca JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = ca.account_id) SELECT ts.client_id AS client_id, ts.card_id AS card_id, ts.card_type AS card_type, ts.gender AS gender, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', '2026-10-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', ts.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%m-%d', '2026-10-01') < STRFTIME('%m-%d', ts.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS client_age, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, ts.trans_id AS trans_id, ts.largest_transaction_amount AS largest_transaction_amount, ts.transaction_type AS transaction_type, ts.transaction_date AS transaction_date, ts.balance_after_transaction AS balance_after_transaction, CASE WHEN ts.largest_transaction_amount >= 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN ts.largest_transaction_amount >= 5000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS transaction_category, CASE WHEN NOT l.loan_id IS NULL THEN 'Has Loan' ELSE 'No Loan' END AS loan_status, l.amount AS loan_amount, o.order_id AS order_id, o.bank_to AS bank_to FROM trans_stats AS ts JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ts.district_id LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = ts.account_id LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = ts.account_id WHERE ts.amount_rank = 1 ORDER BY ts.largest_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 1
